email.subject: Two new free courses: Code in Place X and Probability for AI
email.body_norm: A message from our friends at Stanford School of Engineering's Code in Place: This fall, we're launching two new courses that rethink what online learning looks like in the age of AI. Free to take, open to everyone. Code in Place X 6-Week Program beginning on October 12, Orientation starts on October 7 * Learn to program — and to explain what you build, a skill that matters more as AI writes more of the code. * Meet weekly with your volunteer section leader and group, in one of the largest teaching communities of any course in the world. * Walk away able to build working programs and clearly communicate your work.
